# Copilot Instructions — Silly Wizard

## What this project is
A GameMaker (GML) bagpipe practice game. The player performs on a MIDI chanter; the game plays the tune, scores the performance, and renders a scrolling notebeam visualizer.

## Before making any change — read first
- **`WORKSPACE_MAP.md`** — primary navigation guide. Contains: architectural constraints, key scripts, global-state inventory, struct schemas, UI architecture, playback callback flow. **Read this before planning any change.**
- **`PROJECT_PLAN.md`** — implementation log and pending work items.

## Key architectural constraints
- **No GameMaker `ds_*` data structures.** Use structs for key-value data and plain arrays for sequences. This is a hard project constraint.
- **Prefer reuse over creation.** If a global, struct shape, or function already exists for a purpose, use it. Check `@reads`/`@writes`/`@callers` tags (greppable) to understand data flow.
- **One authoritative owner per global.** Every global must have one owning script that initialises it. Document new globals in the Global State Inventory in `WORKSPACE_MAP.md`.
- All GML functions must have `/// @function` / `/// @description` / `/// @param` / `/// @returns` header blocks. Cross-system functions also need `/// @reads`, `/// @writes`, `/// @objects`, `/// @callers` — see the template in `WORKSPACE_MAP.md`.
- When adding or changing any function, also update its row in the Script Registry in `WORKSPACE_MAP.md`.
- If the function reads/writes a global not yet in the Global State Inventory, add it there.

## Key integration patterns
- **New button:** configure instance in `roomui/RoomUI/RoomUI.yy`, wire via `button_script_index` in `scr_button_scripts.gml`.
- **New global:** initialise in `obj_game_controller` Create event; document in Global State Inventory.
- **New tune event type:** add to preprocess pipeline (`scr_preprocess_tune`), handle in `script_tune_callback` (`scr_tune_scripts`), log in `event_history_add` (`scr_event_log`).
- **New UI window/layer:** register layer in `obj_ui_controller` Create event; add toggle handler in `scr_button_scripts`.

## Language and framework
- **GameMaker Language (GML)** — proprietary scripting language. Syntax resembles JavaScript. See GML docs for built-ins.
- Extension: **Giavapps MIDI** (`extensions/GiavappsMIDI/`) — provides `midi_*` functions. See `Giavapps MIDI documentation.md`.
- UI uses GameMaker Layers + custom `obj_UI_parent` / `obj_btn_base` / `obj_field_base` objects. See UI sections of `WORKSPACE_MAP.md`.

## Content pipeline (how tune data is created)
Tune JSON files in `datafiles/tunes/` are **not hand-authored** — they are generated by a VBA pipeline running in `Silly Wizard Work.xlsm` (Excel workbook):

```
ABC notation → modParseABC (Excel VBA) → tune.json → scr_tune_load_json (GML)
```

- **`EXCEL_VBA_MAP.md`** — full VBA module reference (entry points, pipeline stages, column constants, config).
- **`TUNE STRUCTURE JSON.md`** — `tune.json` schema consumed by GML.
- **`TUNE STRUCTURE EXCEL.md`** — 23-column event grid layout in the Excel workbook.
- VBA source mirrors (read-only): `scripts/Excel - Parse_ABC.txt`, `scripts/Excel - TuneExport.txt`, `scripts/Excel - Performance_Analysis.txt`.

## Other domain docs
- **`TRANSITION_TUNE_TEMPLATE.md`** — how to author transition tunes (ABC patterns, set ordering, verification checklist).
- **`METRONOME.md`** — metronome scheduling design.
- **`UI_SETUP_HOWTO.md`** — how to wire up new UI layers/instances.

## Folder layout (quick reference)
| Folder | Contents |
|---|---|
| `scripts/` | GML scripts (tune, MIDI, UI, scoring, game viz, event log, …) |
| `objects/` | GameMaker objects (controllers, UI base objects, game viz, player) |
| `roomui/RoomUI/` | UI layer definitions (manually placed instances) |
| `datafiles/tunes/` | Per-tune JSON + CSV files (generated by Excel pipeline) |
| `datafiles/` | `embellishments.json`, `sets/` |
| `extensions/GiavappsMIDI/` | Third-party MIDI extension |
